title: •URoRRuR’R’R
caption: •URoRRuR’R’R (V)
game_text: Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Tusken Raider: opponent’s weapon destiny draws here are -2; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck; and other Tusken Raiders here are forfeit +4.
lore: *Leader* of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.

Base card A New Hope (1996); copyright not legible at 350. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350).
